seoTitle: How to Fix ChatGPT 'Unable to Load Conversation'
metaDescription: Fix the ChatGPT error where conversation history won't load in the app or website with these troubleshooting steps.
intro: When ChatGPT conversations stop showing up or history fails to load, whether on the website or mobile app, it can feel like your chats are gone for good. This guide walks through the common causes and fixes so you can restore access to your saved chat history.

steps.heading: Identify where the issue is happening
steps.body: Note whether the problem occurs on the website, the mobile app, or both, since the fix steps can differ slightly.

steps.heading: Refresh or restart the app
steps.body: Reload the ChatGPT website or fully close and reopen the mobile app to force it to re-fetch your history.

steps.heading: Clear cache or app data
steps.body: Clear your browser cache on web, or clear the app's cached data on mobile, then try loading your history again.

steps.heading: Log out and back in
steps.body: Sign out and sign back into your account to refresh your session and reconnect to your saved conversations.

steps.heading: Check for known outages
steps.body: Look at OpenAI's status page to see if there's a broader issue affecting conversation history loading.

faq.question: Will my old conversations be permanently lost?
faq.answer: In most cases, conversations aren't actually deleted — the loading issue is usually temporary and resolves with a refresh or cache clear.

faq.question: Is this error more common on mobile or web?
faq.answer: It can happen on either, though app-specific cache issues are a frequent cause on mobile while browser cache is more common on web.

faq.question: Does logging out risk losing my chat history?
faq.answer: No, logging out simply resets your session and does not delete your saved conversations.

faq.question: What should I do if the issue continues after trying these fixes?
faq.answer: If the problem persists across devices and after clearing cache, it's worth checking OpenAI's status page or reaching out to their support.
